decisions.reason: Changing the physical breakout-header pitch to 1.27 mm does not alter the documented ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments.
The breakout-header pitch does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module family, model, variant, or part number.
The 1.27 mm value applies to the ESP32 full-pin breakout, not the separate panel-control JST connectors or their signals.
The battery connector remains a distinct JST-PH 2.0 mm interface; the source changes only the ESP32 breakout-header pitch.
The breakout-header pitch does not change the 5V boost enable GPIO, control behavior, converter, or powered loads.
The physical pitch of the ESP32 breakout does not alter the addressable LED supply, data GPIO, selected part, or logic-level interface.
The breakout-header pitch does not affect native USB data routing, connector sourceability, or programming-port behavior.
The source concerns the ESP32 through-hole breakout and does not change any sensor-board connector type, pitch, signal assignment, or fanout policy.
The ESP32 breakout-header pitch has no effect on battery protection circuitry or cutoff behavior.
The source does not change the battery NTC connection, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The breakout-header pitch does not affect the charge-status display method, external charge LED connector, or associated resistor configuration.
Changing the breakout-header pitch does not modify the separate requirement to place the ESP32 antenna at the PCB edge.
